title: dial params
description: Connects to a remote kamune server. Over a relay, connecting to the relay and the relay handshake are limited to 15 seconds.

relay_addr.description: Relay server address, host:port with an optional scheme: wss:// (the default), tls://, ws:// or tcp://. A trailing ?insecure=true turns off TLS certificate checks. ws://, tcp:// and ?insecure=true let an on-path attacker read the relay password and tokens, and are logged as a warning. Required when transport is "relay".

peer_pub_b64.description: Base64-encoded public key of the target peer.

p2p_token.description: Hex-encoded P2P token from the server: 32 hex characters for a token the broker assigned, 64 for a static token. Required when transport is "p2p". The dial waits at most 30 seconds for the broker to match it with the server.
